column3: Direct parallel: certainty arrives as the terminal event that closes the prior interval.
Channel parallel links good speech and a traversable praise-oriented route to the praise-prostration sequence.
Contrasts repeated demands for a sign with the receptive stance in which certainty is possible.
Clarifies certainty as inseparable from what is true, without defining the service command.
Part of the immediate surah sequence of warned communities and its eventual outcome.
Frames demanded decisive proof as requiring genuine authority, relevant to certainty's arrival.
Clarifies certainty's truth-grounded character but adds no temporal or devotional link.
Immediate context: reorients attention, sorrow, and bodily posture before the closing commands.
Directly grounds worship in the Creator-Lord relationship and ongoing care.
Distinguishes certainty through direct encounter, illuminating the arriving endpoint.
Direct predecessor: praise and prostration give the concrete devotional posture carried into 15:99.
Only a faint servant-Lord resonance; it adds little to the command's duration or certainty.
Shows certainty as behaviorally effective before direct encounter, preserving a pre-arrival reading.
Strong worship-praise-prostration parallel, with the channel extending 15:98's bodily reorientation.
Joins worship to shared Lordship and a rightly ordered route.
Sharpens exclusive worship as an ongoing practice, though without the certainty endpoint.
Continues the immediate surah pattern of decisive outcomes after wrongdoing.
Reorients a named celestial object under Lordship, supporting worship's proper direction.
Shares a temporal form but concerns compulsion into belief rather than continuing worship.
Directly supplies the hostile-speech pressure answered by praise, prostration, and continued service.
Pairs exclusive worship with warning of a painful day, linking service and an approaching outcome.
Provides a prior-message-before-destruction sequence, a secondary model for deferred finality.
Only a remote local subchannel association; it does not clarify the closing command.
Relates certainty about the last reality to established devotional practice.
Offers a conditional 'until' and a no-grief posture, but its subject differs from 15:99.
Pairs endurance under divine judgment with praise at rising, strongly extending the pressure-response channel.
Combines Lordship and certainty; the channel also joins it to the constricted-chest response.
Shows knowledge arriving before final adjudication, a secondary temporal parallel.
Immediate local warning-history context for the surah's closing reassurance and command.
Contrasts worship's proper Lord-directed allegiance with ingratitude and misdirected attachment.
Makes servanthood primary even before bestowed office, directly strengthening the worship reading.
Local account of a requested delay until resurrection, a secondary endpoint parallel.
Keeps worship exclusive and portable under displacement, though the route is only mixed.
Shows that the same disclosure can increase certainty or provoke doubt, preserving divergent reception.
Pairs patience with recurrent praise, strongly matching the response to pressure in the focus channel.
Adds final-day accountability under the Lord's comprehensive knowledge.
Directly presents universal arrival before God in the status of servants, joining endpoint and servanthood.
Immediate local example of turning away from signs before the surah's closing counsel.
Shows separation from rival worship and reliance on provision, a secondary worship-direction parallel.
Treats misdirected worship as a relationship involving worshipper and object, clarifying the contrary side.
Immediate context of comprehensive questioning, reinforcing the accountability horizon around the close.
Directly joins certainty to comprehensive Lordship over the whole created field.
Frames teaching and study as forming Lord-oriented servants rather than rival allegiance.
Channel parallel supplies regular inward and voiced remembrance around the praise-prostration response.
Links patience and certainty to sustained, effective conduct before judgment, not merely final recognition.
Presents all striving as reaching the Lord, strongly illuminating certainty as an arriving terminus.
Immediate local illustration of apparent security before the decisive outcome.
Offers only a broad signs-and-certainty relation with no close devotional or terminal connection.
Directs desire toward the Lord, a secondary parallel to exclusive, continuing service.
Local Lord-mercy reading supports perseverance, but does not directly explain certainty's arrival.
Contrary example of turning away from signs; the arrival link remains indirect.
Traces guidance toward the Lord into inward restraint, supporting worship as reoriented conduct.
Channel parallel continues praise into night and after prostration, extending the focus's devotional sequence.
Treats signs as material grounds for certainty, but not the terminal certainty of 15:99.
Places the final settling with the Lord, a close endpoint parallel.
Immediate surah outcome: a decisive event overtakes those who rejected the signs.
Contrasts accepting guidance now with postponing response until punishment arrives face-to-face.
No retained channel or reading gives this flight episode a focused connection.
Immediate local grounding in the all-creating, all-knowing Lord supports leaving outcome and burden to Him.
Only a mixed reversal of expected help and approaching loss; it is not a close worship parallel.
Adds an inescapable, decreed encounter as a secondary model for the focus's endpoint.
Immediate local conclusion that accumulated gains fail before the decisive outcome.
The generic narrative-arrival wording and mixed route add little to 15:99.
Places truth from the Lord against doubt, a concise certainty contrast.
Immediate local decree of a morning cutoff, a secondary temporal echo of a fixed endpoint.
Shows received signs and a corresponding final consequence, supporting the warning side of arrival.
Adds Lord-directed patience as an active posture adjacent to sustained service.
Channel parallel supplies scheduled morning-evening praise, extending the focus response rhythm.
States worship as the encompassing purpose, directly anchoring the command's central act.
Immediate local duration to the Day of Judgment offers a secondary endpoint frame.
Immediate context joins assured final arrival with a present gracious response, closely anticipating 15:99.
Presents the given Book as continuing guidance, a secondary support for sustained practice.
Adds an anticipated Lord-given fulfillment, but only indirectly relates to certainty or worship.
Immediate local gathering under wise knowledge supplies an accountability horizon.
Broadly links guidance and mercy with certainty but lacks a close temporal or worship relation.
Adds the Lord's watchful accounting posture, relevant to the final horizon but not its command.
Channel parallel joins praise with final judgment, connecting present devotion to the culminating scene.
Offers an afterlife-certainty association but does not develop service or arrival.
Pairs forbearance with waiting until God's command arrives, a secondary structural parallel.
Immediate provision of the recited gift supports the closing sequence, though indirectly.
Uses lack of certainty to expose failed creator-accountability claims, a contrary epistemic parallel.
Contrasts demanded direct sight with a sudden overpowering encounter, relevant to final certainty.
Only a remote local creation subchannel association; it does not clarify the closing command.
Generic certainty about divine judgment adds little after stronger certainty cards.
The conditional faith requirement is not a close parallel to continuing worship until certainty.
A faint channel resonance around gratitude offers limited focused value.
Immediate challenge demanding angels frames decisive arrival as perilous, not neutral evidence.
Further distinguishes enduring worship identity from the contrary allegiance.
Immediate self-identification as clear warner supplies the mission context for the closing command.
Directly joins worship and God-conscious orientation as the beneficial course.
Adds return to the Lord as an endpoint that reverses temporary human control.
Only a mixed Lord-care resonance; it adds no close endpoint or service relation.
Direct parallel: persistent doubt ends only with a sudden Hour or irreversible punishment.
Lordship affirmation is relevant but too general after stronger worship and endpoint parallels.
Servant language in an exodus scene provides only a distant relation.
Adds Lord-sourced inner repair and guidance, supporting the reorientation under pressure.
No retained route ties this allocation of accounting to the focus's service-until-certainty relation.
Adds the severe authoritative grasp as a possible contrary outcome at the final horizon.
Completion of the Lord's true and just word supports certainty, without a direct worship link.
Directly presents God's command arriving in decisive true judgment, closely paralleling the focus endpoint.
Immediate answer to the angel demand: decisive descent comes with truth and ends the period of delay.
Contrary reception: even an overwhelming sign can be dismissed, qualifying claims that more evidence itself creates certainty.
Immediate mission directive under hostility, completing the pressure-to-devotional-response setting of the close.
Immediate assurance of sufficiency against mockers, directly relieving the pressure named before 15:98-99.
Immediate contrary allegiance to another deity, with the threatened transition to knowing.
Directly combines exclusive worship with the rightly ordered religion.
Closest ongoing-service parallel: worship is paired with patience in that worship.
Directly joins worship with established remembrance, clarifying the practice carried forward.
Pairs patience under hostile speech with recurring praise across the day and night.
Revelatory formula directly grounds exclusive worship in divine oneness.
Directly combines bowing, prostration, and worship of the Lord.
Joins reliance on the ever-living Lord with praise, a secondary endurance-and-devotion parallel.
Strongly parallels the sign-response of prostration and praise without arrogance.
Direct divine command to worship on the straight way, with a strong but less immediate relation.
Direct worship command identifies the straight path, closely reinforcing 15:99's service.
Directly frames worship as exclusively and sincerely directed to God.
Reiterates commanded, sincere worship as a sustained prophetic obligation.
Calls for return and submission before punishment arrives, a close temporal contrast to delayed response.
Directly joins calling upon God with exclusive, sincere devotion.
Directly states a command to worship God alone and reject rival worship.
Frames signs as continuing until truth becomes clear, a secondary route toward certainty.
Directly combines shared Lordship, worship, and the straight path.
Explicitly contrasts the true, doubtless Hour with denial, supporting the certainty horizon.
Pairs patience with praise before sunrise and sunset, extending the same pressure-response rhythm.
Continues the praise practice into the night, completing the scheduled-devotion parallel.
The unavoidable approach of death supplies a concrete terminal-arrival parallel.
Immediate sequel to a certainty statement: praise follows the completed certainty framing.
Immediate sequel to a certainty statement: glorification of the Lord follows it.
Links continual remembrance with exclusive devotional commitment.
Establishes repeated remembrance across the day, reinforcing worship as sustained practice.
Directly joins nighttime prostration with prolonged glorification.
Presents human striving as moving toward a meeting with the Lord, a terminal-direction parallel.
Directly joins prostration and nearness, strongly extending the 15:98 posture.
Directly states worship as commanded, sincere, and exclusively God-directed.
Shows decisive divine arrival as the point beyond which delayed belief no longer benefits.
Uses the arrival of angels or divine command as a delayed but decisive judgment horizon.
The trumpet scene supplies a final, irreversible transition relevant to certainty's arrival.
Explicitly declares the coming Hour beyond doubt, closely strengthening the terminal certainty reading.
Presents the promised punishment as unavoidable, supporting the irreversible-event reading.
Strengthens the truth-certainty dimension, though without an explicit service command.
Joins the true divine promise to the contrast of those lacking certainty.
Directly concludes with prostration and worship, a close formal parallel to 15:98-99.
Immediate surah contrast: heedless delay is left to run until a future transition into knowing.
Immediate local frame of fixed, known decrees behind a community's eventual outcome.
Immediate local statement that appointed terms cannot be advanced or deferred, sharpening fixed finality.
Immediate demand for angels supplies the hostile proof-demand answered by 15:8 and the focus's endpoint.
Immediate warning context for the divided reception that precedes comprehensive questioning.
Immediate description of fragmenting the recited whole, supplying the conduct examined in 15:92-93.
Immediate completion of the oath to question all, directly carrying accountability into the final mission commands.
